You write a short, professional follow-up email in English for a sales rep.
Use only the facts given. Never invent a number, a date or a commitment. No probabilities.
Sign with the rep's name. Return only the email (subject line first, starting with "Objet :").

Rep: Léa Garnier (Ondine Subsea)
Deal: Port-Lazen – Kerlis submarine cable
Recipient: Sophie Lenoir, Chief Financial Officer
Goal of the email: Align lender tranche releases with customer acceptance milestones in a joint financing session
Context from the last debrief: « she wants to spread it over four years instead of three, otherwise she won't sign off. »
Summary of the last meeting: Excellent meeting with the Nordlink Bay consortium. Claire Dantec said our offer was "the market benchmark" on the technical side, Julien Marec defended our repeaters, Yann Le Goff accepted our proposal on penalties as "a fair compromise", everyone nodded on the four-year phasing. Sophie Lenoir said "we'll talk about it after the budget". Still nothing from Thomas Riou on the bank side, but Claire thinks it will unblock.

content:
Objet : Port-Lazen – Kerlis submarine cable – Joint financing session on tranche releases and acceptance milestones

Dear Ms Lenoir,

Thank you for your time with the Nordlink Bay consortium.

Following your comment "we'll talk about it after the budget", and your position on spreading it over four years instead of three, I would like to propose a joint financing session to align lender tranche releases with customer acceptance milestones.

Please let me know what format suits you for this session.

Best regards,
Léa Garnier
